questions.question: What is the occasion of Psalm 59?
options: When the Philistines seized hold of David in the city of Gath
When Saul sent men to watch David's house in order to kill him
When the Ziphites betrayed David into the hand of Saul
When Absalom rose up against his father to take the throne
questions.answer: When Saul sent men to watch David's house in order to kill him

questions.question: What does David call God in this psalm?
options: My banner, my shield, and the gracious lifter up of my low bowed head
My fortress, my strength, and the God who shows me steadfast love
My portion, my cup, and the very joy and gladness of my heart
My shepherd, my guide, and the faithful keeper of my soul
questions.answer: My fortress, my strength, and the God who shows me steadfast love

questions.question: David resolves to sing of God's strength and steadfast love in the morning.
O my Strength, I will sing praises to you, for you, O God, are my _____.
Each evening they come back, howling like _____ and prowling about the city.
